info.title: Quark API
info.description: Configure Quark and read your server's logs from your own code.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Read the configuration and change server settings.

tags.name: Log channels
tags.description: Where each category of log is sent.

tags.name: Logging settings

tags.name: Ignore options

get.description:
Returns every part of the server's Quark configuration in one response.

The response includes the credentials of the webhooks Quark posts logs through, and the server's API token records. Treat it as sensitive.
Returns Quark's record for the server.

404.description: Quark has no record of this server.
No settings are stored for this server.

patch.description:
Changes the server's language.

`locale` is written as a language key such as `en-US`, but read back as a numeric ID. See the API introduction for both.

404.description: No settings are stored for this server.

get.description: Returns the channel each category of log is sent to.

404.description: No log channels are stored for this server.

patch.description:
Sets the main log channel or the channel for one or more categories. Include only the fields you want to change.

Set a field to a channel ID to send that category there, or to null to make it follow the main channel again. Quark registers its webhook in each channel you set, so it needs Manage Webhooks there.

`category_nsfw` is the channel for message logs from age-restricted channels. It only accepts a channel that is age-restricted itself. Set it to null to clear it.

400.description:
A channel could not be set. `error` says why. The status code can be another 4xx or 5xx code, depending on what went wrong.

Also returned when `category_nsfw` names a channel that is not age-restricted. Nothing in the request is applied in that case. If Quark cannot check the channel at that moment, the status is 503 instead.

404.description: No log channels are stored for this server.

category_nsfw.description: Age-restricted (message logs from age-restricted channels). Must be an age-restricted channel.

get.description: Returns how many logs per minute are going to each log channel, compared with what Discord accepts. Use it to see whether a channel is over Discord's rate limit. The figures are estimates.

200.description: One entry per busy channel. Empty if none.

404.description: No options are stored for this server.

patch.description:
Changes server-wide logging options. Include only the fields you want to change.

`format_type` needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite and is rejected without it. `ignore_bot_targets` and `ignore_bot_executors` are saved on any plan but only take effect on Quark Pro or Pro Lite. On the free plan, actions by or to bots are not logged.

400.description: `modlog_lock_after` is not null or a whole number of seconds from 0 to 31536000. Nothing in the request is applied.

403.description: The token cannot do this, or `format_type` was sent for a server without Quark Pro or Pro Lite. Other fields in the same request have already been applied when this is returned.

404.description: No options are stored for this server.

pluralkit_integration.description: Turn PluralKit compatibility on or off.

pro_promotions.description: Allow a note in logs when part of a log needs Quark Pro.

ignore_bot_targets.description: Do not log actions done to bots.

ignore_bot_executors.description: Do not log actions done by bots.

format_type.description: 0 is Standard, 2 is Standard (no embed). Needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

buttons.description: The standard buttons to show on logs. Replaces the current set. 0 is User ID, 1 is Support Server, 2 is Customise.

active_ignore.description: Turn Active Ignore on or off for every log type. While it is on, each log is held for about three seconds before it is sent. See the Active Ignore endpoints.

modlog_lock_after.description: How long a modlog's reason can be edited, in whole seconds after the modlog was posted. null for always editable, 0 for never editable. The dashboard offers 3600, 86400, 604800 and 2592000. The largest value accepted is 31536000 (one year).

get.description:
Returns the settings of every log type that has been customised on this server, not only `log_id`. Pick the row whose `log_type` you want.

The response includes webhook credentials for log types that have their own channel. Treat it as sensitive.

parameters.name: log_id
parameters.description: A log type ID. See the log types page.

200.description: One row per customised log type.

404.description: No log type has been customised on this server.

patch.summary: Update settings for a log type
patch.description:
Changes the settings of one log type.

On the free plan only `enabled` can be changed. The other fields need Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

Send `log_channel` in a request of its own. When it is present, only the channel is changed and the other fields in the same request are ignored. A 202 for `log_channel` does not confirm that the channel was accepted. Read the settings back, or run the troubleshooter, to check.

parameters.name: log_id
parameters.description: A log type ID. See the log types page.

403.description: The token cannot do this, or a field needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite. `error` names the field.

enabled.description: Switch this log type on or off.

log_channel.description: A channel for this log type alone, or null to follow its category. Needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

color.description: Embed colour as an integer RGB value, or null for the default. Needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

format_type.description: Format for this log type, or null to use the server-wide format. Needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

ignore_bot_executors.description: Do not log this type when a bot did it. Needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

ignore_bot_targets.description: Do not log this type when it was done to a bot. Needs Quark Pro or Pro Lite.

active_ignore.description: Turn Active Ignore on or off for this log type. Free on every plan. While it is on, each log of this type is held for about three seconds before it is sent.

get.description: Returns every ignore entry for the server, across all lists, not only `ignore_type`. Filter the result by `ignore_type` yourself.

parameters.name: ignore_type
parameters.description: Which ignore list.

404.description: The server has no ignore entries.

post.description: Adds one entry to an ignore list.

parameters.name: ignore_type
parameters.description: Which ignore list.

400.description: `value` is missing, empty or longer than 100 characters, or `ignore_type` is not a valid list.

value.description: A channel, category, user or role ID, or the exact message content, depending on the list.

delete.description: Removes one entry from an ignore list. The entry to remove goes in the request body. Succeeds whether or not the entry existed.

parameters.name: ignore_type
parameters.description: Which ignore list.

400.description: `value` is missing, or `ignore_type` is not a valid list.

value.description: A channel, category, user or role ID, or the exact message content, depending on the list.

post.summary: Ignore the next logs about a target
post.description:
Asks Quark to leave out the next logs about one target: a member, message, channel, role or other thing a log is about. Send it just before, or just after, your bot does something you do not want logged.

Active Ignore has to be switched on for the log type, or for every log type, before a request has any effect. A request that is not used expires on its own.

202.description: Accepted. The request is stored and Quark leaves out the next matching logs.

400.description: `guild_id` is not a valid server ID, or the body is invalid: it is not JSON, `id` or `type` is missing or not valid, `logType` is not a whole number, or `count` or `time` is not a number above zero.

id.description: The ID of the target. For an invite, its code.

type.description: What kind of thing `id` is. 0 member, 1 channel, 2 emoji, 3 server, 4 invite, 5 none, 6 message, 7 role, 8 thread, 9 user, 10 stage, 11 event, 12 webhook, 13 sticker. A log matches when it has a target of this kind with this ID. A deleted message, for example, has the message (6) as a target.

logType.description: Only ignore logs of this type. Leave it out to ignore a log of any type. See the log types page.

count.description: How many logs to leave out. A fraction is rounded up.

time.description: How long the request lasts, in seconds. A fraction is rounded up. Anything over 300 is shortened to 300 (five minutes).

post.summary: Ignore the next logs of things done by a user
post.description:
Asks Quark to leave out the next logs of things done by one user, usually your own bot. Send it just before, or just after, the bot acts.

Active Ignore has to be switched on for the log type, or for every log type, before a request has any effect. A request that is not used expires on its own.

202.description: Accepted. The request is stored and Quark leaves out the next matching logs.

400.description: `guild_id` is not a valid server ID, or the body is invalid: it is not JSON, `id` is missing or not a user ID, `logType` is not a whole number, or `count` or `time` is not a number above zero.

id.description: The user ID of whoever does it.

logType.description: Only ignore logs of this type. Leave it out to ignore a log of any type. See the log types page.

count.description: How many logs to leave out. A fraction is rounded up.

time.description: How long the request lasts, in seconds. A fraction is rounded up. Anything over 300 is shortened to 300 (five minutes).

get.description: Returns every tag in the server.

post.description:
Creates a tag. The new tag's ID is not returned. List the tags to find it.

A tag needs `content`, an `image`, or both.

Servers without Quark Pro can have 25 tags.

400.description: A field is missing or too long, the tag has neither content nor an image, or the image is not a web address.

402.description: The server has 25 tags and does not have Quark Pro.

409.description: A tag with that name already exists.

tag_name.description: The tag's name. Saved in lower case. Cannot be changed later.

content.description: The text of the tag. Can be left out when `image` is given.

color.description: Embed colour as an integer RGB value.

image.description: Image URL, starting with `http://` or `https://`. Can be the whole tag.

patch.description:
Changes a tag's content, colour or image. The name cannot be changed.

Send `content` as an empty string to take the text off a tag that has an image. An image cannot be removed once set.

A value that fails validation is ignored without an error, except a new `image` that is not a web address, which is a 400. List the tags to confirm the change.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: The tag's ID, from the tag list.

400.description: A new `image` is not a web address, or `color` is not a number.

content.description: New text. An empty string removes the text if the tag has an image, and is ignored if it does not.

image.description: New image URL, starting with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: The tag's ID, from the tag list.

get.description:
Returns the server's logs, newest first. This is the same data the log viewer shows.

How far back you can read depends on the server's plan: the last hour on the free plan and Pro Lite, 30 days on Quark Pro. A request that reaches further back is cut to that window and `walled` is true.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to search for. Matches whole words in message content, and parts of names, channels, roles and reasons.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only entries after this time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Limited to what the server's plan allows.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries before this time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: One or more categories. Repeat the parameter for each.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: One or more log type IDs. Repeat the parameter for each.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: A channel ID.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: A user ID.

parameters.name: memberRole
parameters.description: Whether `member` did the action, had it done to them, or either.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: A role name, or part of one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entries per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `cursor` from the previous page.

500.description: The logs could not be read. Try again later.

get.description: Returns the members who appear in the server's logs within the window its plan allows. Up to 2,000.

Returns the logs matching the filters as a CSV file, newest first, up to 50,000 rows, within the history window the server's plan allows.

Columns: `timestamp`, `log_id`, `log_type`, `log_name`, `summary`, `executor_id`, `executor_name`, `target_id`, `target_name`, `channel_id`, `channel_name`, `role`, `name`, `reason`, `count`, `content`, `content_after`, `delivered`, `delivery_reason`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to search for. Matches whole words in message content, and parts of names, channels, roles and reasons.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only entries after this time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Limited to what the server's plan allows.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries before this time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: One or more categories. Repeat the parameter for each.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: One or more log type IDs. Repeat the parameter for each.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: A channel ID.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: A user ID.

parameters.name: memberRole
parameters.description: Whether `member` did the action, had it done to them, or either.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: A role name, or part of one.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of the `summary` column.

500.description: The logs could not be exported. Try again later.

get.description: Returns the server's notifications: recent changes to Quark's configuration and who made them. These are what the bell on the dashboard shows.

parameters.name: notification_id
parameters.description: The notification's `notificationId`.

get.description: Checks the server's configuration, Quark's permissions in each log channel and the delivery path, and returns what it found. This is the report `/troubleshoot` and the dashboard show.

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Set to `0` to skip the checks that call Discord. Faster, but deleted channels and full webhook slots are not detected.

post.description: Applies one of the automatic fixes from a troubleshooting report. Send the finding's `fix` object as the request body.

202.description: The fix was started and will finish shortly. Returned for `initialise_guild`.

400.description: The fix cannot be applied automatically. For webhook fixes, another 4xx or 5xx code with an `error` field is returned if the channel could not be set.

post.description:
Sends one real, visible test log through the full delivery path and reports whether it arrived. Limited to one per server per minute.

The response is 200 even if the log did not arrive. Check `ok` and `stage`.

429.description: A test log was sent less than a minute ago, or you are being rate limited.

get.description: Searches the server's members or channels by name. Useful for turning a name into an ID before adding an ignore entry.

parameters.name: structure
parameters.description: What to search.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The text to search for.

200.description: The matches. Each has at least an `id`.

get.description:
Returns a record of each API token for the server. The tokens themselves are never returned. Tokens are created on the dashboard.

Only tokens created under the selected bot are listed. Add `?bot=pro` to see the ones created on the Quark Pro tab.

404.description: The server has no API tokens.

delete.description: Revokes a token. It stops working immediately.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: The token's `unique_id`, from the token list.

delete.description:
Deletes Quark's entire configuration for the server: log channels, ignore options, per-log settings, automation rules, tags, dashboard access and the server's API token records. It also deletes the history of changes to modlog reasons. This cannot be undone.

Revoke the server's tokens first. The reset removes their records, so they can no longer be listed or revoked afterwards.

400.description: `guild_id` is not a valid server ID.

GuildId.name: guild_id
GuildId.description: The server's ID. Must be the server the token was created for.

Bot.name: bot
Bot.description: Set to `pro` to act on the Quark Pro bot's configuration. Leave out for the main Quark bot.

Forbidden.description: The token belongs to a different server, or is not an Admin token.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

first_log_at.description: When the first log was delivered to this server, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

LogChannels.description: Where each category of log is sent. A category that is null follows the main channel. A category set to `"0"` is switched off. `category_files` and `category_nsfw` are special categories: they cannot be switched off, and null means they follow the Messages category.

main_channel.description: The main log channel. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_modlog.description: Modlogs. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_members.description: Members. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_actions.description: Actions. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_text.description: Messages. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_voice.description: Voice. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_files.description: Files (deleted attachments). A channel ID, or null to follow the Messages category and then the main channel.

category_nsfw.description: Age-restricted. The channel for message logs from age-restricted channels. A channel ID, or null when it is not set and those logs go wherever Messages logs go.

category_server.description: Server. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_roles.description: Roles. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_channels.description: Channels. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

category_quark.description: Quark Events. A channel ID, `"0"` if switched off, or null if not set.

spoilers.description: 1 if re-posted files are marked as spoilers.

format_type.description: Log format. 0 is Standard, 2 is Standard (no embed).

ignore_bot_targets.description: 1 if actions done to bots are not logged.

ignore_bot_executors.description: 1 if actions done by bots are not logged.

active_ignore.description: 1 if Active Ignore is on for every log type. See the Active Ignore endpoints.

buttons.description: Bitfield of the standard buttons shown on logs. 1 is User ID, 2 is Support Server, 4 is Customise.

pro_promotions.description: 1 if logs may include a note when part of a log needs Quark Pro.

modlog_lock_after.description: How long a modlog's reason can be edited, in seconds after the modlog was posted. null means always editable. 0 means never editable.

LogTypeSettings.description: Settings for one log type. A log type only has a row once one of its settings has been changed.

log_type.description: The log type ID. See the log types page.

enabled.description: 0 if this log type is switched off.

log_channel.description: The channel this log type is sent to, or null to follow its category.

format_type.description: Format override, or null to use the server-wide format.

color.description: Embed colour as an integer RGB value, or null for the default.

ignore_bot_executors.description: 1 or 0 to override the server-wide Actions by bots setting for this type, or null to follow it.

ignore_bot_targets.description: 1 or 0 to override the server-wide Actions on bots setting for this type, or null to follow it.

active_ignore.description: 1 if Active Ignore is on for this log type. Active Ignore applies to a log type when it is on here or in the server-wide options.

log_channel_webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook Quark uses for this log type's own channel.

log_channel_webhook_token.description: Token of that webhook. Treat it as a secret.

ignore_value.description: A channel, category, user or role ID, or the message content, depending on `ignore_type`.

IgnoreType.description: 0 channels, 1 channel categories, 2 executor users, 3 target users, 4 message content, 5 executor roles, 6 target roles.

locale.description: The numeric ID of the server's language. See the API introduction for the list.

tag_id.description: The tag's ID. Use it to update or delete the tag.

tag_name.description: The tag's name, in lower case.

color.description: Embed colour as an integer RGB value.

unique_id.description: The token's ID. Use it to revoke the token. This is not the token itself.

creator.description: The user ID of whoever created the token.

Config.description: Every part of the server's configuration. Each value is an array of rows, or null if nothing is stored.

serverlogConfigChannelWebhooks.description: The ID and token of the webhook Quark uses in each log channel. Treat these as secrets.

ratePerMinute.description: Estimated logs per minute being sent to the channel.

ceilingPerMinute.description: Estimated number Discord will accept per minute.

parkedLogType.description: The log type Quark has paused on this channel, if any.

timestamp.description: When it happened, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

executor.description: Who did it. The ID is `"0"` for changes made through the dashboard or API.

via.description: The bot `executor` acted through, when a moderator did this through a moderation bot. Absent or null otherwise.

channel.description: The channel involved. `name` can be an empty string.

content.description: Message content. For an edit, the content before.

contentAfter.description: For an edit, the content after.

messages.description: The messages the log carries: one for a delete, two for an edit, many for a bulk delete. Attachments are listed by name and size only.

heldBy.description: Set when an automation rule held the log back, so it was not posted to Discord.

notices.description: The notices automation rules added to the log.

total.description: How many entries match the filters from this page onwards. On the first page it is the total number of matches.

retentionMs.description: How far back this server's plan lets you read, in milliseconds.

walled.description: True if the request asked for more history than the plan allows.

cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null when there are no more.

categoryCounts.description: Number of entries in each category that match the other filters. The `category` filter itself is not applied.

notificationType.description: A numeric type code, as a string.

Fix.description: An automatic fix. Take it from the `fix` field of a finding in the troubleshooting report.

automatic.description: True if this endpoint can apply the fix. A fix with `automatic: false` has to be done by hand and is rejected.

id.description: The kind of problem, for example `NO_LOG_CHANNEL` or `MISSING_WEBHOOK`.

scope.description: What the finding applies to: a channel, category, log types, an ignore entry or permissions.

oneOf.description: A fix that has to be applied by hand.

incomplete.description: Checks that could not be run.
